# Inherited Skills: verified license scope

## Current pinned body upgrades

The API/interface-design and context-engineering Skills now use reviewed bodies from addyosmani/agent-skills commit `2686b620fc1fed2e8f60c704839c766b8594c6b6`, with Firefly frontmatter and explicit host/authorization adaptations. The discovery workflow is a Firefly-maintained adaptation of that source, using actual registered IDs and existing tool contracts rather than unavailable mandatory Skills. These three Skills retain complete MIT licenses and per-Skill NOTICE files inside the ZIP. `license-provenance.json` records these current bodies under `currentBodyUpgrades`; earlier per-file matching records describe the prior bodies, not byte identity of the new adaptations. Other current Skill bodies remain unchanged in this compatibility round.

These notices accompany skills-snapshot.zip in the same distributed firefly-skills directory. The complete licenses in licenses/ must remain with the snapshot. They do not grant rights to unrelated Skills.

The distributed `xlsx/scripts/xlsx_workspace.py` now includes a Firefly-maintained worksheet-relationship path fix. Its source-layer replacement is `scripts/packaging/skill-adaptations/xlsx/scripts/xlsx_workspace.py`; the prior archive member had SHA-256 `676a2521264b2c87425233df12591f9fe5e0b207289806bad9d8ea828e680545`, and the adapted member has SHA-256 `7743ec3e6cb37a0d632b3133ca068b4ddff70288a5f493fbd8d35867dc413320`. The earlier provenance record identifies the inherited source; it does not claim the adapted file is byte-identical to that source. This change does not replace the remaining XLSX files or their source notices.

The 14 as- Skills derive from Addy Osmani / agent-skills; the eight ecc- Skills derive from Affaan Mustafa / ECC. The body comparison removes only frontmatter and outer whitespace. Original frontmatter differs from product metadata. Several upstream revisions have the same body; no unique original checkout is claimed. Per-file hashes, all matching revisions, and the exact license revisions are recorded in license-provenance.json. No script or resource exists inside these 22 snapshot directories.

These files are inherited/adapted works, not wholly original Firefly work. Existing Superpowers notices inside the snapshot remain applicable only to those nine Skills. The two licenses above do not cover other directories; their separate scopes and unresolved evidence are documented below.
